data.long_meaning: Tejasvi is a beautiful Sanskrit and Hindi name that means 'radiant', 'shining', or 'glowing'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'tejas', which means 'brightness', 'illumination', or 'radiance'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to be intelligent, wise, and radiant in their own unique way. The name Tejasvi carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining, Glowing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tejasvi usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining, glowing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
